text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Zimbabwe has lost more than Z$320 million potential revenue since a ban on ivory trade was imposed in 1989, and continues to lose more than Z$40 million a year while ivory stocks pile up.

- Zimbabwe's justice, legal and parliamentary affairs ministry is instituting corrective measures following numerous complaints over missing files and documents at the civil courts in the capital Harare.
- Small-scale tobacco growers are expected to increase their earnings by over Z$40 million this season with an estimated production of more than 3.5 million kilograms of the crop.
